scope: Pre-commit regression tests for Qwen LLM/TTS integration, Conda service management and script export; real inference evidence is recorded separately.

backend.warning: Existing Starlette TestClient httpx deprecation; no dependency changes made

data_safety: Backend tests use isolated temporary databases. Existing services, databases, .env files, weights and generated audio were not modified by this regression run. These runtime assets are excluded from Git.
execution_note: ASGI and database regressions ran outside the restricted execution sandbox to permit local cross-thread communication. No temporary runtime patches were needed.
not_validated: Human listening acceptance of pronunciation, spoken-text completeness and voice distinction

commands.backend: cd backend && conda run --no-capture-output -n podcast-backend python -m pytest -q
commands.local_llm: cd llm && conda run --no-capture-output -n podcast-llm python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
commands.tts: cd tts && conda run --no-capture-output -n podcast-tts-service python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
commands.cross_module: from repo root: conda run --no-capture-output -n podcast-tts-service python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
